title: Nginx Operations
description: Production operations dashboard for Nginx OSS using access logs and nginx-prometheus-exporter stub_status metrics.

panels.title: Nginx Available
panels.description: Last successful Nginx stub-status scrape. A value of 0 means the exporter could not reach Nginx.

queries.query: nginx_up

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: HTTP requests per second from Nginx stub_status.

queries.query: rate(nginx_http_requests_total[5m])

panels.title: Active Connections
panels.description: Current active client connections handled by Nginx.

queries.query: nginx_connections_active

panels.title: 5xx Requests
panels.description: Access-log requests returning a server error in the selected time range.

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM "nginx_access" WHERE status >= 500

panels.title: Request Volume
panels.description: Access-log request volume over time.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "nginx_access" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: HTTP Status Codes
panels.description: Response volume by HTTP status code. Watch for sustained 4xx or 5xx growth.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1, cast(status AS varchar) AS breakdown_1 FROM "nginx_access" GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Connection States
panels.description: Reading, writing, and waiting Nginx connections.

queries.query: nginx_connections_reading
nginx_connections_writing
nginx_connections_waiting

panels.title: Response Bytes
panels.description: Response bytes written per second from access logs.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, sum(bytes_sent) / 60 AS y_axis_1 FROM "nginx_access" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Top Requested URLs
panels.description: Most frequently requested URLs, limited to 20 results.

queries.query: SELECT path AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "nginx_access" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Recent Server Errors
panels.description: Most recent access-log server errors for rapid triage.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, cast(status AS integer) AS status, method, path, client_ip, request_time, upstream_time FROM "nginx_access" WHERE status >= 500 ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Total access-log requests in the selected time range.

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM "nginx_access"

panels.title: Client Errors
panels.description: Access-log requests returning 4xx responses.

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM "nginx_access" WHERE status >= 400 AND status < 500

panels.title: Server Errors
panels.description: Access-log requests returning 5xx responses.

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM "nginx_access" WHERE status >= 500

panels.title: Bytes Sent
panels.description: Total response payload bytes sent in the selected time range.

queries.query: SELECT sum(bytes_sent) AS value FROM "nginx_access"

panels.title: Status Class Volume
panels.description: 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, and 5xx response volume over time.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1, concat(cast(cast(floor(status / 100) AS integer) AS varchar), 'xx') AS breakdown_1 FROM "nginx_access" GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Status Code Breakdown
panels.description: Response counts by exact HTTP status code.

queries.query: SELECT cast(status AS varchar) AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "nginx_access" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC

panels.title: URLs Causing 4xx
panels.description: Top client-error URLs. Validate expected redirects and stale links before alerting.

queries.query: SELECT path AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "nginx_access" WHERE status >= 400 AND status < 500 GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: URLs Causing 5xx
panels.description: Top server-error URLs for incident routing.

queries.query: SELECT path AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "nginx_access" WHERE status >= 500 GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Request Status by URL
panels.description: Bounded URL and response-code breakdown for drilldown.

queries.query: SELECT path, cast(status AS integer) AS status, count(*) AS requests, sum(bytes_sent) AS bytes_sent FROM "nginx_access" GROUP BY path, status ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Avg Request Time
panels.description: Average Nginx end-to-end request time from access logs.

queries.query: SELECT avg(request_time) * 1000 AS value FROM "nginx_access"

panels.title: P95 Request Time
panels.description: 95th percentile end-to-end request time. Use this rather than the average for SLOs.

queries.query: SELECT approx_percentile_cont(request_time, 0.95) * 1000 AS value FROM "nginx_access"

panels.title: P95 Upstream Time
panels.description: 95th percentile upstream response time. Zero values represent direct Nginx responses.

queries.query: SELECT approx_percentile_cont(upstream_time, 0.95) * 1000 AS value FROM "nginx_access"

panels.title: Slow Requests
panels.description: Requests taking at least one second end to end.

queries.query: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM "nginx_access" WHERE request_time >= 1

panels.title: Request Latency
panels.description: Average and P95 end-to-end request latency over time.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, avg(request_time) * 1000 AS y_axis_1, approx_percentile_cont(request_time, 0.95) * 1000 AS y_axis_2 FROM "nginx_access" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Nginx vs Upstream Latency
panels.description: Separates total Nginx request time from upstream response time.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, avg(request_time) * 1000 AS y_axis_1, avg(upstream_time) * 1000 AS y_axis_2 FROM "nginx_access" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Slowest URLs
panels.description: URLs ranked by P95 request time, bounded to 20 results.

queries.query: SELECT path AS x_axis_1, approx_percentile_cont(request_time, 0.95) * 1000 AS y_axis_1 FROM "nginx_access" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Slow Request Samples
panels.description: Latest slow request samples with client, URL, status, and upstream timing.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, client_ip, method, path, cast(status AS integer) AS status, request_time * 1000 AS request_ms, upstream_time * 1000 AS upstream_ms FROM "nginx_access" WHERE request_time >= 1 ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Unique Clients
panels.description: Distinct client IPs observed in access logs for the selected time range.

queries.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT client_ip) AS value FROM "nginx_access" WHERE client_ip != ''

panels.title: Unique URLs
panels.description: Distinct requested URLs in the selected time range.

queries.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT path) AS value FROM "nginx_access"

panels.title: Error Clients
panels.description: Distinct client IPs receiving 4xx or 5xx responses.

queries.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT client_ip) AS value FROM "nginx_access" WHERE status >= 400 AND client_ip != ''

panels.title: Largest Response
panels.description: Largest single response body sent in the selected time range.

queries.query: SELECT max(bytes_sent) AS value FROM "nginx_access"

panels.title: Top Client IPs
panels.description: Most active clients, limited to 20 results to prevent cardinality overload.

queries.query: SELECT client_ip AS x_axis_1, count(*) AS y_axis_1 FROM "nginx_access" WHERE client_ip != '' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top URLs by Response Bytes
panels.description: URLs transferring the most response data.

queries.query: SELECT path AS x_axis_1, sum(bytes_sent) AS y_axis_1 FROM "nginx_access" GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY y_axis_1 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Active Clients Over Time
panels.description: Distinct clients per minute. Sudden changes can indicate traffic shifts or abusive clients.

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '1 minute') AS x_axis_1, count(DISTINCT client_ip) AS y_axis_1 FROM "nginx_access" WHERE client_ip != '' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: Client Error Sources
panels.description: Clients and URLs producing the most non-success responses.

queries.query: SELECT client_ip, path, cast(status AS integer) AS status, count(*) AS requests FROM "nginx_access" WHERE status >= 400 GROUP BY client_ip, path, status ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Latest Requests
panels.description: Latest access-log records for direct request inspection.

queries.query: SELECT _timestamp, client_ip, method, path, cast(status AS integer) AS status, bytes_sent, request_time, upstream_time FROM "nginx_access" ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Nginx Up
panels.description: Nginx exporter scrape health. Alert when this is 0.

queries.query: nginx_up

panels.title: Active
panels.description: Current active client connections.

queries.query: nginx_connections_active

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description: Idle keepalive client connections.

queries.query: nginx_connections_waiting

panels.title: Accepted Conn/s
panels.description: Accepted client connections per second.

queries.query: rate(nginx_connections_accepted[5m])

panels.title: Active Connections
panels.description: Current active Nginx connections over time.

queries.query: nginx_connections_active

panels.title: Connection State Breakdown
panels.description: Reading, writing, and waiting connection counts over time.

queries.query: nginx_connections_reading
nginx_connections_writing
nginx_connections_waiting

panels.title: Connection Handling Rate
panels.description: Accepted and handled connection rates should normally track closely.

queries.query: rate(nginx_connections_accepted[5m])
rate(nginx_connections_handled[5m])

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: Nginx stub_status request rate over time.

queries.query: rate(nginx_http_requests_total[5m])

panels.title: Exporter Process CPU
panels.description: CPU consumed by nginx-prometheus-exporter. This does not represent Nginx worker CPU.

queries.query: rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job="nginx"}[5m]) * 100

panels.title: Exporter File Descriptors
panels.description: Open file descriptors used by nginx-prometheus-exporter.

queries.query: process_open_fds{job="nginx"}
